title: lk3d scene
description: A 3D figure as data: parts made of shapes, each with a name and a note, that the reader turns, takes apart, cuts open and moves. Other fields are allowed (a page's own data).

lk3d.description: The version of this format the scene is written in (1). Optional; a later engine that changes the format reads older versions.

w.description: The stage's width in proportion to h (16 by default).

h.description: The stage's height in proportion to w (10 by default).

narrow.description: The stage's proportions on a narrow screen, e.g. "1 / 0.9".

title.description: What the figure shows; also the canvas's label when alt is not given.

alt.description: A description of the model for screen readers.

style.description: The first look: pen (near-white, thin lines; the default), studio (realistic) or ink (drawn).

theme.description: The colours of the page behind the model, its lines and words (auto: light or dark, as the reader's system is set). None: each look's own.

dist.description: Distance from the target (default: to fit).

target.description: The point looked at (default: the middle).

minZoom.description: How close the reader may zoom, as a share of the distance that fits the whole model (0.02: 50 times closer).

projection.description: perspective (the default) or ortho: parallel lines stay parallel, as in a technical illustration.

explodeZoom.description: How far the camera steps back when the model is taken apart (0.5).

explodeShift.description: Where the view moves when the model is taken apart.

edges.description: Lines where a part's faces meet at an angle: drawn in the pen look unless false; true draws them in every look.

check.description: What the geometry check (lk3d check, lk3d/lint) is to excuse, by name: what the scene means on purpose.

allow.description: Pairs of part ids that may run into each other when taken apart or as a motion moves, or hide each other's label (two pictures of one molecule, shown in turn).

float.description: Parts (ids or groups) that hang in the air on purpose, or true: all of them (planets, molecules side by side).

ground.description: A shadow under the model (true by default).

section.description: The cut: a plane, or false to offer none. What lies on the side its normal points to, beyond offset along it, is cut away; a page may move it (set({ section }))

motions.description: Parts that move together as one value goes along a range: a piston's stroke as the crank turns, a sleeve sliding back, a valve opening. Set or played by the page (fig.motion(id)) and, when named, by the reader (a slider and a play button); run through its range by the geometry check.

joints.description: Parts posed by how they are joined, not by keys for each: a crank driven by a motion, a piston held by its rod, a rod aimed at the crank pin, a cam that follows at half speed. A joint's value comes from a motion, another joint, a rod, an aim, or the page (set({ joints })).

scale.description: Honest scale: a bar that keeps its true length as the view zooms, and/or a note saying what is not to scale.

bar.x-message: a scale bar needs its length (scene units) and label ("5 cm")

scale.x-message: scale is a bar ({bar: {length, label}}) and/or a note ({note: "not to scale"})

models.description: glTF 2.0 models (.glb) by name, for {model: name} shapes.

unit.description: What one scene unit is (m): the laws of liquids and gases (g, R) are worked out in it.

vessels.description: Parts that hold liquids or a gas: the radius of their inside at each height, and an outlet they pour through.

liquids.description: Liquids in vessels, drawn by lk3d as bodies that fill their vessel to the level their volume gives; liquids in one vessel stack by density; an open outlet pours by Torricelli's law into the liquid below.

gases.description: Gases under a piston: the piston rests where pV = nRT puts it (n moles at T kelvin under p pascals and the piston's weight).

parts.description: The parts of the model, each a list of shapes with a name and a note.

data.description: The .glb as base64 (a build tool may fill it in from a file).

file.description: The path to the .glb, read into data before the scene is drawn (lk3d check and render, a build tool); the engine itself reads only data.

title.description: Its name in the credit line.

author.description: Who made it (credited under the figure).

url.description: Where it comes from (the credit links to it).

source.description: Where it comes from: a scan of a real specimen, a scientific dataset, an artist's model, or made by AI (then called an illustration under the figure).

model.x-message: a model needs its .glb: data (base64) or file (a path)

handle.description: The reader moves the part with the pointer or the keys, held to one rule.

turn.description: Degrees about an axis through center; without min and max it goes round and round.

slide.description: A distance along an axis from where the part is drawn.

path.x-message: an along handle needs a path of at least two points

along.description: A place on a path, 0 at its start to 1 at its end.

min.description: The least value (degrees, distance or place).

value.description: Where the part is drawn (default 0, or min).

label.description: What a screen reader calls it.

unit.description: A unit read out after the value.

moves.description: Other parts or groups carried with it.

handle.x-message: a handle is exactly one of turn: {axis, center}, slide: {axis} (with min and max), along: {path}

note.description: Shown when the part is pointed at (may hold simple HTML).

group.description: Parts of one group move, hide and are framed together (set({hide}), focus, a handle's moves).

material.description: How it reflects light in the studio look (and how much light wraps round into it, for soft materials).

color.description: Its colour in the drawn look.

studioColor.description: Its colour in the studio look (default: color).

glow.description: The colour it glows when the page lights it (set({glow})).

cut.description: false: the part stays whole when the model is cut open (a stand, a frame, a base).

edges.description: Whether its edges are drawn (by default yes, except on soft shapes: models, blobs, trees, terrain, scatter, molecules, DNA).

accent.description: Keeps its full colour in the pen look (where other parts are near-white).

opacity.description: Always see-through: 1 is solid (glass about 0.35; a part made only of a model's glass, KHR_materials_transmission, is 0.35 and glass unless it says otherwise).

xray.description: Becomes see-through with the "See through" control.

hidden.description: Not drawn at first (set({hide}) changes it).

explode.description: Where it moves to when the model is taken apart.

rot.description: Turns the whole part (degrees about x, y, z).

label.description: Where its leader line points, or false for no label.

spin.description: Turns with the figure's spin angle, set({spin}): about an axis through center, ratio times as fast.

handle.description: The reader moves this part with the pointer or the keys.

surface.x-message: surface is {kind: brushed|knurl|ribs|grain|skin|cast, scale, strength} (positive numbers)
surface.description: Fine surface detail in the studio look (WebGL 2): kind, bumps per unit, strength (0.3 to 1).

refract.description: Glass that bends what is behind it (studio look, WebGL 2): 1 for a lens.

shapes.x-message: a part needs its shapes (a list of one or more)
shapes.description: What the part is made of: one or more shapes. (none for a liquid's or a gas's part: lk3d makes its body)

refract.x-message: refract is for a glass part (material: glass)

lathe.description: A body of revolution around the x axis: a profile of [position along x, radius] points.

cylinder.description: A cylinder along x from x0 to x1; ri makes it hollow, r1 a cone.

r.description: Its radius (at x0, for a cone).

ri.description: The radius of the hole along its axis (0: solid).

sphere.description: A sphere of this radius (seg: 32 by default).

torus.description: A ring [R, r] around the x axis.

tube.description: A round wire along a path of [x, y, z] points (r: its radius; closed: a loop).

helix.description: A coil along x: {r, x0, x1, turns, wire}.

turns.description: How many times it winds round (8).

loop.description: A rounded rectangular winding: {a, b, R, wire, corner, turns, gap}.

R.description: The height y it lies at, in the x-z plane (0.4).

corner.description: The radius of its rounded corners (0.03).

turns.description: How many turns, stacked one above the other (1).

gap.description: The distance in y from one turn to the next (0).

ellipsoid.description: An egg shape with semi-axes [a, b, c].

capsule.description: A rod with round ends along x: {r, x0, x1}.

x0.description: Where its straight part starts along x (-0.5); the round end reaches r beyond.

x1.description: Where its straight part ends along x (0.5).

blob.description: An irregular round body: {r, amp, freq, seed, stretch}.

amp.description: How far the radius varies, as a share of r (0.15).

freq.description: How close together the bumps are (1.6).

stretch.description: Stretched along x, y and z ([1, 1, 1]).

shell.description: A sphere, hollow inside ri, with the wedge outside from..to (degrees) cut away: {r, ri, from, to}.

ri.description: Its inner radius (0: a solid ball).

from.description: The angle about x where it starts, degrees (0).

to.description: The angle about x where it ends, degrees (360).

tree.description: Branching, tapering tubes: {at, dir, length, r, levels, branches, spread, shrink, taper, bend, seed}.

r.description: The trunk's radius at its base (0.04).

levels.description: Levels of branches, the trunk the first (3).

spread.description: How far a branch turns from its parent, degrees (35).

shrink.description: A branch's length as a share of its parent's (0.65).

taper.description: A branch's radius at its end as a share of its start (0.6).

molecule.description: Atoms (CPK colours) and bonds: {atoms: [{el, at}], bonds: [[i, j, order]], scale, style}.

el.description: Its element's symbol: H, C, O, Na…

r.description: Its radius in ångström (default: the element's).

items.x-message: an atom is {el: "C", at: [x, y, z]}, with r and color if they differ from the element's

atoms.description: The atoms, each an element at a place.

items.x-message: a bond is [i, j] or [i, j, order]: two atoms by their place in atoms (from 0), order 1, 2 or 3

bonds.description: Bonds between two atoms, by their place in atoms (from 0), single unless an order is given.

style.description: ball (ball-and-stick, the default) or space (space-filling, without bonds).

dna.description: A double helix with base pairs: {pairs, seq, scale}.

seq.description: One strand's bases, A T G C, repeated as needed.

rise.description: The distance from one base pair to the next along x (0.34 nm).

twist.description: Degrees the helix turns from one base pair to the next (34.3: 10.5 pairs a turn).

groove.description: Degrees between the two backbones around the axis (150).

extrude.description: A flat outline made solid: {outline, depth}.

outline.description: The outline's [x, y] points, in order (a simple polygon, concave or not).

terrain.description: A block of ground with rock layers: {size, res, base, height, layers, top, tilt}.

size.description: Its size along x and z ([2, 2]).

res.description: Grid steps along each side of the top (24).

base.description: The height of its top above its bottom (y = 0), before the hills (0.6).

amp.description: How far the hills rise and the valleys fall (0.12).

freq.description: How close together the hills are (1.5).

layers.description: Rock layers, the top one first; the last reaches down to the bottom.

tilt.description: Dips the layers along x, degrees (0).

orbit.description: An ellipse with the Sun at a focus: {a, e, wire}.

e.description: The eccentricity: 0 for a circle, less than 1 for an ellipse (0).

blade.description: A twisted airfoil blade along y: {root, span, chord, tip, twist, thickness, camber, sweep}.

root.description: How far from the x axis it starts (0.2).

tip.description: Its width at the tip (default: chord).

twist.description: Degrees its section is turned at the root, less towards the tip, 0 there (35).

thickness.description: The section's greatest thickness, as a share of the chord (0.1).

camber.description: How much the section curves, as a share of the chord (0.04; 0: symmetric).

sweep.description: How far the tip lies along x from the root, as a share of the span (0).

scatter.description: Copies of a shape at random places: {shape, n, within, avoid, size, seed}.

within.x-message: within is one of {sphere: r}, {shell: [ri, r]}, {box: [x, y, z]}
within.description: Where the copies go, around the shape's place: inside a sphere, a shell or a box ({sphere: 1}).

items.x-message: a region to avoid is {sphere: r, at: [x, y, z]}

avoid.description: Balls where no copy goes, [{sphere: r, at}] (a nucleus inside a cell).

size.description: The least and the greatest scale of a copy ([1, 1]).

seed.description: Picks the places, turns and sizes (1).

detail.description: Each copy's detail as a share of the shape's own (0.5).

model.description: A model listed under the scene's models (node: one node of it).

at.description: Where the shape is, in the part.

scale.description: Stretched: [x, y, z], or one number for all three.

color.description: Its own colour (vertex colours), over the part's; on a textured model, in place of its base colour map (its relief kept).

detail.description: More or less detail than the figure's quality: 0.5 for a shape repeated hundreds of times, 2 for a close-up.

repeat.x-message: repeat is a number of copies, or {n, step, start, axis: x|y|z}
repeat.description: Copies around an axis (x unless axis says): n of them, step degrees apart (360 / n) from start (0).

node.description: With model: one node of the model (and what is under it).

closed.description: lathe: a closed outline (a ring; a sector's is closed unless false); tube: a loop.

smooth.description: lathe: normals blended across the profile's corners, for a curved surface (by default its edges stay crisp).

from.description: lathe: the angle about x where a sector starts, degrees (0).

to.description: lathe: the angle about x where a sector ends, degrees (360); its two sides are closed flat.

seg.description: lathe, cylinder, sphere: segments around (lathe and cylinder 48, sphere 32; 8 for a tiny bead).

shape.x-message: a shape is exactly one of: lathe, cylinder, box, sphere, torus, tube, helix, loop, ellipsoid, capsule, blob, shell, tree, molecule, dna, extrude, terrain, ring, orbit, blade, scatter, model

id.description: Unique among the scene's motions: what the page names it by.

name.description: What the reader's slider says (no name: no slider, the page drives it).

range.description: From and to: degrees of a crank, a fraction from 0 to 1, a time: whatever the keys are written in.

value.description: Where it starts (the start of its range).

loop.description: Played on round and round (a crank), else to its end and back.

speed.description: How far along its range it goes in a second when played (the whole range).

items.description: Parts that move one way: moved, turned, or both (moved, then turned).

move.description: Keys [t, [x, y, z]]: at the motion's value t, moved by [x, y, z].

turn.description: Turned about an axis through center: keys [t, degrees].

ease.description: A smooth start and stop at each key (else straight from key to key).

items.x-message: a track moves its parts (move), turns them (turn), or both

tracks.description: Parts it moves by keys (none when it only drives joints).

part.description: The part that is the vessel (its glass).

at.description: Where height 0 is, on the vessel's upright axis ([0, 0, 0]).

inside.description: Its inside, bottom to brim: [height, radius] (an outlet's stem included, so it fills as it pours).

outlet.description: Where it pours from: a bore at its bottom, the stream leaving at tip.

tip.description: Where the stream leaves (in the scene).

dir.description: Which way it leaves ([0, -1, 0]: down; sideways for a hole in a tank's side).

valve.description: The motion that opens it (its range: shut to open); else the page opens it (fig.vessel(id).set({open})).

cd.description: How much of the bore the stream fills (0.6, a sharp-edged hole).

part.description: The part drawn as this liquid (its name, note, colour; lk3d makes its shape).

volume.description: How much (scene units cubed: cm³ in a scene in cm).

density.description: Its density (1): liquids in one vessel stack, the densest at the bottom.

into.description: The liquid (in a vessel below) it becomes when its vessel pours.

part.description: The part drawn as this gas.

piston.description: The part that rests on it (set on the gas wherever the scene drew it).

mass.description: The piston's mass, kilograms (0): its weight adds to the pressure.

id.description: Unique among the scene's joints: what the page and other joints name it by.

parts.description: Part ids or groups it moves (a part on one joint only).

parent.description: A joint whose movement its parts share first (a rod rides on its piston).

turn.description: It turns its parts: degrees about axis through center.

slide.description: It slides its parts: scene units along axis.

value.description: Its value when nothing drives it (0: as the parts are drawn).

drive.description: Its value from a motion: the motion's own value (its id), or scaled or read off keys.

ratio.description: Its value is the other's times ratio (1), plus offset.

keys.description: Keys [the other's value, this joint's value], in order: a cam's lift, a gear train that isn't a ratio.

ratio.description: Its value is the other's times ratio (1), plus offset.

keys.description: Keys [the other's value, this joint's value], in order: a cam's lift, a gear train that isn't a ratio.

follow.description: Its value from another joint's: a gear (ratio), a cam's follower (keys).

rod.description: A slide held by a rod of fixed length (a piston): from at, a point carried by joint, to pin, a point of its own parts; the rod is as long as they are apart at rest.

aim.description: A turn that keeps its parts pointing at at, a point carried by joint (a connecting rod, on its piston, aimed at the crank pin).

joint.x-message: a joint turns its parts (turn) or slides them (slide)
